instruction: Candid romantic photograph, medium close-up. Sunny outdoor field with blurred trees. The woman with long brown hair (R1) in a sherpa-lined denim jacket is on the right, looking down lovingly with a gentle smile. The man with short dark hair and a beard (R2) in a matching denim jacket is on the left, looking up at her. The woman cradles the man's head with her left hand as they embrace closely and gaze at each other. Warm, bright natural sunlight creates soft backlighting.
